name: Slateport City
lines:
Want to know the trick to battling?
If you ask me, it’s raising different kinds of
Pokémon in a balanced way.
It’s no good to make just one of your Pokémon strong.
If you end up facing a type that it’s weak to,
it might not stand a chance.

You trade Pokémon with your friends, right?
If the Pokémon you trade is holding an item when
you send it out, it’ll make them twice as happy!

Aha! Pokémon Journal
If a Pokémon with the Super Luck Ability holds a
Scope Lens, its critical-hit ratio will be further boosted.
